hero.intro: Student leader, designer and technology enthusiast working at the intersection of education, participation and creative communication.
hero.supporting: I turn complex ideas into clear projects, useful systems and opportunities for young people.

about.lead: I connect ideas, people and institutions through leadership, design and communication.
paragraphs: I’m a student at the Mathematical Grammar School in Belgrade, Board Member & International Officer — Union of High School Students of Serbia, and a designer working across education, student participation and visual communication.
I combine analytical thinking, creativity and responsibility to turn complex ideas into clear communication, useful projects and work that lasts.

items: Representing high school students through UNSS
Leading school media and student initiatives
Creating visual communication for youth and activist initiatives

story.description: Discover what matters. Design what works. Deliver what lasts.
steps: Understand the people, context and real problem.
Turn insight into a clear solution, system or story.
Take responsibility for making it real and lasting.
